description: This line plot illustrates the loss ratio (%) as a function of TFLOPs for five different model configurations: Vanilla, SepLLM with 64 and 128 hidden dimensions, and two variants of SepLLM with 64 hidden dimensions under different training regimes (H/T). The x-axis represents TFLOPs on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick labels at intervals of 1e7, 2e7, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis represents Loss Ratio (%) on a linear scale, ranging from 94 to 100. The Vanilla model is depicted by a purple line with triangle markers, which remains nearly flat across the entire x-axis range, starting at approximately 100% and ending at approximately 99.5%. The SepLLM (n=128) model is shown by an orange line with circle markers, starting at approximately 98.5% and rising to approximately 99.5% by the end of the range. The SepLLM (n=64) model is represented by a blue line with cross markers, starting at approximately 97% and increasing to approximately 99.5%. The SepLLM (n=64, H/T) model is shown by a green line with diamond markers, starting at approximately 97.5% and rising to approximately 100%. The SepLLM (n=64, H/T) model is also depicted by a red line with square markers, starting at approximately 94% and rising to approximately 99% before slightly declining toward the end of the range.
